_meta.description: toolBox skill registry. Anchor-based architecture — 13 anchors, one per category.

anchors.name: meta-tooling
anchors.usageNotes: Skill creation, discovery, auditing, configuration. Highest confidence anchor.

anchors.name: testing
anchors.usageNotes: QA with Tier 1-6 structure. Tier 1/2 auto-trigger, Tier 3/4/6 manual. Covers TDD, E2E, debugging, multi-language.

anchors.name: backend
anchors.usageNotes: API design, server patterns, database/ORM, caching, Docker, Django/Spring Boot/Next.js.

anchors.name: ai-agent
anchors.usageNotes: Agent loops, LLM pipelines, evaluation, retrieval, cost optimization, on-device, enterprise ops.

anchors.name: frontend
anchors.usageNotes: UI/UX design, React patterns, hooks, state management, animations, accessibility, Liquid Glass.

anchors.name: language-specific
anchors.usageNotes: Go, C++, Python, Java, JPA/Hibernate coding standards and patterns.

anchors.name: security
anchors.usageNotes: OWASP review, scanning, Django/Spring Boot security, code quality enforcement.

anchors.name: devops
anchors.usageNotes: Deployment, Docker, CI/CD, verification loops (generic + Django + Spring).

anchors.name: workflow
anchors.usageNotes: Planning, execution, code review, branching, parallel agents, git worktrees, verification, plus Karpathy coding discipline (think-before-coding, simplicity-first, surgical-changes).

anchors.name: content
anchors.usageNotes: Content strategy, article writing, social media, presentations, headless CMS selection and modeling.

anchors.name: business
anchors.usageNotes: Document processing, visa translation, investor materials/outreach, market research.

anchors.name: mobile-native
anchors.usageNotes: React Native/Expo, SwiftUI, Swift 6.2 concurrency, actor persistence, protocol DI.

anchors.name: game-development
anchors.usageNotes: Universal game dev fundamentals (loops, physics, collision, ECS, rendering, controls) + Cocos Creator 3.x TypeScript standards. Extensible for Unity/Godot/Unreal.

externalPlugins.name: claude-mem
externalPlugins.installPath: ~/.claude/plugins/ (Claude Code 托管，toolBox 不存副本)
externalPlugins.workerPortNote: 固定分配 37700+(uid%100)，本机 uid=501 → 37701。端口确定后不再更改（ERR-006 预防规则）；健康检查 http://127.0.0.1:37701/health
capabilities: session-context-injection (SessionStart 注入近 10 session 摘要)
mem-search (FTS5 全文检索 skill: search/timeline/get_observations)
externalPlugins.usageEntry: mem-search skill（plugin 内置）；降级路径 sqlite3 只读查询
externalPlugins.governanceNote: 运行时 plugin 而非知识文本，不适用 anchor 知识合并（skill_ingestion Phase 3 对象为 markdown 切片）。plugin 本体由 Claude Code 管理，遵守五层架构无冗余副本规则。

externalPlugins.name: codebase-memory-mcp-pro
externalPlugins.toolPath: Tool/codebase-memory-mcp-pro/ (lean 参考面入 git；internal/+vendored/ 共 ~1.1G 生成 grammar 已 .gitignore)
installOptions: A 首选: npx -y codebase-memory-mcp (或 uvx；上游 0.8.1，stdio，零本地构建)
B fork 增强: Tool/codebase-memory-mcp-pro/scripts/build.sh → build/c/codebase-memory-mcp (含 explore/blast-radius depth)
C 上游脚本: curl|bash (不推荐，供应链暴露)
externalPlugins.role: 代码结构记忆层（第三类记忆；claude-mem=会话记忆，Obsidian KI=知识记忆）
capabilities: index_repository / list_projects / delete_project / index_status (建图与管理)
explore (fork: blast-radius+邻居+带行号源码一击) / trace_path (调用链 BFS) / detect_changes (git diff→受影响符号+风险分级)
get_architecture (架构/热点/死代码) / search_graph / search_code / query_graph (Cypher) / get_code_snippet
externalPlugins.usageEntry: CTO Planning Step 2.5 — A 级项目画像 P1-P3 命中则按项目 index；B 级项目内按问题选工具。同域与 claude-mem smart-explore 二选一。
externalPlugins.governanceNote: 运行时 MCP server / 第三方二进制，非 markdown 知识，不走 anchor 合并（同 claude-mem 先例）。延后安装、按合格代码项目注册、非全局常驻；toolBox 治理库本身 doc-only 不索引。
